r21d-001.gate_key: ind_polite | B1.1 | write | You want to join an evening Italian course at a language school, but the website shows no start date. Write one polite question to the school. |

key.model: Could you tell me when the next Italian course starts?
must: Start politely: *Could you tell me …?*, *Do you know …?* or *I'd like to know …*
Then a question word or *if*: *… when the next course starts*.
After the question word the subject comes first, with no *do / does*: *when the course starts*, not *when does the course start*.
Put the subject before the verb: *when the course starts*, not *when starts the course*.

item.q: You want to join an evening Italian course at a language school, but the website shows no start date. Write one polite question to the school.
item.why: A polite start, then *when* and the order of a statement, with no *does*: *Could you tell me when the next Italian course starts?*
